observations.text: Trial is randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled; primary outcome is death or moderate/severe BPD at 36 weeks PMA; 326 ibuprofen and 327 placebo randomized; adjusted RR 1.09 (95% CI 0.98 to 1.20).
Dynamic randomization via secure Web system, probabilistic minimization; concealed assignments; infants from multiple births randomized individually.
Primary outcome evaluated at 36 weeks PMA; oxygen-reduction challenge differentiates mild/moderate BPD; outcomes recorded from clinical notes or trial assessments.
Outcome analyses had 324 ibuprofen and 322 placebo participants after consent withdrawals.
Table 2 primary outcome estimates 220/318 vs 202/318, adjusted RR 1.09 (0.98-1.20); footnote details primary outcome missingness.
Primary outcome assessment possible for 318/324 ibuprofen and 318/322 placebo; required data missing for additional 10 infants.
